updates.title: 2026-10-15 | Delivery gates, independent handoffs and platform plan
updates.body:
Completed engineering support: all six internal v1 stages now use preflight/output checks, fresh attempts, fixed input snapshots, exact predecessor/hash records and stale-result blocking. The recheck CLI and a synthetic demonstration across five folders on one host are available. The recorded explicit CPU suite passed 453 tests; this is historical implementation evidence, not a new test run from this progress post. The opt-in v2 foundation provides immutable storage, structural contracts and geometry helpers.

The distributed design separates Human 01-04, Object 05 and Physics 06-07 while preserving exact input dependencies. Module 1's plan prioritizes one complete real import/scene/export/reload path, then a two-host rehearsal, then baseline/candidate experiments. Members work across modules; execution and review participants are recorded per task.

Limit: registered reconstruction backends remain fake. No new real baseline, native conversion, cross-machine model run, quality acceptance or official export acceptance is established. Next: obtain one permitted native output sample, implement typed import and scene normalization, and verify export/reload on a complete episode before accepting cross-machine execution.

Submission location: deliveries/platform/<unique-delivery-id>/README.md through a PR to main; large outputs use a new result-specific Release or agreed storage with exact hashes. This review index does not implement native package transport.

updates.title: 2026-10-15 | Human contracts and handoff boundaries ready for adapter work
updates.body:
Shared infrastructure now checks internal human outputs for complete frame coverage, required finite arrays, positive depth scale and valid upstream dependencies. The opt-in v2 foundation separately checks declared native-human shapes and rig/decoder bindings; it does not decode or convert MHR. The native split distinguishes early human/depth bootstrap from formal 01-04 preparation, which requires the metric object asset.

These changes produced no new real-model reconstruction or quality acceptance. Native adapters, receiving-machine import and conversion/reload validation remain pending. Members may develop, execute or review across modules; participants are recorded per task.

Next: obtain one permitted real bootstrap/native output sample, implement its typed adapter, and verify original-frame mapping and scale consistency with the object and platform consumers.

Submission location: deliveries/human/<unique-delivery-id>/README.md through a PR to main. Include exact upstream identities, native representation, full frame mapping, checks and missing products. Large native outputs use a new result-specific Release or agreed storage with hashes.

updates.title: 2026-10-15 | Mesh, trajectory and dependency checks implemented
updates.body:
Internal delivery gates now reload object meshes and records, check finite geometry and positive scale, and validate every frame's rigid pose and confidence range. Changed upstream results invalidate dependent deliveries. The v2 foundation adds structural mesh-pose-canonical-frame/scale bindings and episode-local source declarations. These checks can pass synthetic fixtures; they do not establish correct reconstruction.

The native design permits unscaled asset preparation alongside human bootstrap, then metric asset delivery before formal 01-04 preparation and native 05 tracking. No new real tracking result or quality acceptance came from these infrastructure updates. Typed native adapters and cross-machine import remain pending. Roles float across tasks.

Next: deliver one explicitly scaled asset and a native 05 sample with exact upstream identities, then verify full-frame coverage, mesh/origin consistency and occlusion failures with the receiving stages.

Submission location: deliveries/object/<unique-delivery-id>/README.md through a PR to main. Distinguish an unscaled candidate, metric asset and tracking result. Store large meshes/trajectories in a new result-specific Release or agreed storage with exact hashes.

updates.title: 2026-10-15 | Bounded-repair contracts and checked refinement handoffs
updates.body:
The opt-in v2 foundation validates declared repair plans: affected entities/frames, mutable and fixed variables, fit/review partitions, budgets and the exact rollback scene. Registering orientation, contact and occlusion operation names does not implement their solvers. Internal gates require both refined human and object outputs and reject missing or stale dependencies; the registered refine backend still passes inputs through.

The native split gives 06-07 joint inference/post-optimization a coherent-input boundary and keeps research candidates separate from a frozen baseline. No new real improvement or quality acceptance was established. Native adapters, transport and empirical acceptance thresholds remain pending. Participants can change between tasks.

Next: build an independently authored synthetic repair/ablation harness, then compare a bounded candidate against the same real baseline when available, documenting genuine-motion preservation, contact effects, failures and rollback. Self-smoothness alone is not official ACC improvement.

Submission location: deliveries/physics/<unique-delivery-id>/README.md through a PR to main. Bind the fixed baseline and observations, list permitted changes and regressions, and preserve separate candidate outputs. Large artifacts use a new result-specific Release or agreed storage with hashes.
